sprint.objective: Create a provider-neutral, deterministic MyPetNew engineering-agent foundation without changing product functionality.

justifications.engineering/package.json: A dependency-free local package declares only the Node eval command and runtime floor.
justifications..github/workflows/engineering-toolkit.ym: A deterministic, fast, secretless workflow runs the foundation eval suite on relevant changes.

workers.objective: Implement contract, scope, dependency, archaeology, command-runner, and certification modules.
repository_facts: Node 22 and dependency-free node:test scripts are existing repository conventions.
acceptance_criteria: The deterministic core satisfies all required eval scenarios and rejects injection-shaped input.
evidence_requirements: Capture RED, GREEN, and second-pass test evidence.

workers.objective: Define deterministic behavioral evals for the foundation.
repository_facts: Temporary Git repositories are an existing local test pattern.
acceptance_criteria: Every required contract, scope, certifier, dependency, and archaeology scenario is executable.
evidence_requirements: Record test counts and failures exactly.

workers.objective: Document roles, operation, security, provenance, and future least-capability MCP routing.
repository_facts: No Admin application exists at the starting SHA and the root README is stale.
acceptance_criteria: A future sprint can create a contract, scope workers, run guards, and understand certification limitations.
evidence_requirements: Do not include fake execution evidence.

workers.objective: Add a fast deterministic wrapper and path-scoped CI workflow.
repository_facts: Mandatory CI must not invoke models, MCP tools, or production services.
acceptance_criteria: The wrapper and workflow validate examples and run deterministic evals only.
evidence_requirements: Run the wrapper twice and record exact results.

functional: Sprint contracts, scope checks, dependency analysis, Git archaeology, and certification are reusable from a CLI.
regression: No product implementation or test file is changed.
security: No untrusted contract field can inject commands, environment values, or paths outside the repository.
contracts: Reports and sprint examples remain machine-readable JSON.
